headline: Adds monthly UTC account statements API and service
summary: Introduces the Statements module with an HTTP endpoint and StatementService to compute read-only monthly account statements in UTC. Statements calculate opening balance, chronological ledger lines with running balances, and closing balance, restricted to the account owner or staff roles.
business: Customers and authorized staff can now retrieve monthly account statements showing opening balance, chronological transactions, and closing balance in the account currency. Statement access is limited to account owners or staff, and balances round to two decimal places away from zero.

reasons.text: Inclusive upper bounds in ledger queries violate UTC month boundary exclusion
reasons.claim: ledger.EntriesAsync evaluates ranges with inclusive upper bounds. Passing monthStart when retrieving prior entries causes entries at exactly YYYY-MM-01T00:00:00Z to be included in opening balance, while passing monthEnd causes entries at 00:00:00Z on the 1st of the next month to be included in the current month's lines. This violates strict month boundary criteria and causes boundary tests to fail.
reasons.suggested_fix: Filter priorEntries with .Where(e => e.CreatedAt < monthStart) and monthEntries with .Where(e => e.CreatedAt >= monthStart && e.CreatedAt < monthEnd) so that midnight UTC boundary entries are strictly excluded as required.
reasons.say: Midnight UTC transactions on the first of a month appear in wrong-month statements and opening balances, distorting customer figures. Ask the author to fix StatementService to exclude exact month-end boundaries.
reasons.say_facts: This violates strict month boundary criteria and causes boundary tests to fail. Ask for a fix before merging.

reasons.text: StatementsController endpoint and HTTP status mappings have no test coverage
reasons.claim: StatementsController is completely uncovered by tests. The requirement acceptance criteria explicitly specify endpoint routing, [Authorize(Policy = Policies.Customer)], 401 for unauthenticated calls, and exception-to-HTTP-status mappings (400, 404, 403), none of which are validated by any unit or integration tests.
reasons.suggested_fix: Add controller unit or integration tests verifying that GET api/accounts/{id}/statements/{year}/{month} returns 200 OK for valid requests, 401 for unauthenticated calls, 403 when forbidden, 404 on missing account, and 400 on invalid calendar inputs.
reasons.say: Without API tests, unauthorized callers might access customer statements or receive wrong error responses. Ask for tests on StatementsController covering routing, login enforcement, and error status codes.
reasons.say_facts: StatementsController is completely uncovered by tests. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: Tautological assertion recalculates running balance over returned lines without checking expected line order
reasons.claim: The test re-computes running balances by looping over the returned statement.Lines array in whatever sequence the service returned them. Because two transactions share the identical timestamp (10:00:00), an arbitrary or reversed ordering would still pass the assertion loop without verifying expected transaction sequence or reference order.
reasons.suggested_fix: Assert expected line references, individual amounts, and explicit BalanceAfter values for statement.Lines[0], statement.Lines[1], and statement.Lines[2] directly rather than looping and recalculating.
reasons.say: A statement test trusts whatever transaction order the service returns, which could hide misordered entries with identical timestamps from customers and staff. Ask the author to assert the exact expected sequence.
reasons.say_facts: Because two transactions share the identical timestamp (10:00:00), an arbitrary or reversed ordering would still pass the assertion loop without verifying expected transaction sequence or reference order. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: 5 changed method(s) have no usable test evidence
reasons.say: Five new methods covering statement setup and web requests have no test evidence, risking undetected runtime failures for customers and staff. Ask the author to add test coverage before merging.
reasons.say_facts: 5 changed parts of the code are not covered by any working test. Read them yourself or ask for tests.

reasons.text: Reviewer asks a human to check What
reasons.detail: Requirement match is partial: The module structure, routing, models, and authorization checks meet the requirement. However, month boundary handling in StatementService fails to enforce exclusive upper bounds on ledger queries, causing entries at midnight UTC on month boundaries to be included in both opening balance and statement lines.
reasons.say: Customer statements will misreport balances around midnight UTC month boundaries because upper date limits are inclusive. Verify that StatementService excludes exact boundary timestamps from both opening balances and statement lines.
reasons.say_facts: The reviewer is not sure the change does everything the requirement asks. Compare the change with the requirement.
